text.p: For the Three For the Six
Months Ended June 30, Months Ended June 30,

(a) The lower-than-normal tax rate in 1997 and 1996 reflects the realization of a portion of the Federal tax benefit not recognized in prior years due to certain accounting limitations. (b) The three month and six month periods ended June 30, 1997 and 1996 reflect the impact of dividends on Senior Preferred Stock of $531 (or approximately $.11 per share) and $1,062 (or approximately $.21 per share), respectively. In addition, the three month and six month periods ended June 30, 1997 reflect dividends declared on the Series B Preferred Stock of $762 (or $.15 per share) and $1,246 (or $.25 per share), respectively; and an accretion deduction of $95 (or $.02 per share) and $184 (or $.04 per share), respectively, related to reinstating the new Series B Preferred Stock to its mandatory redemption value over a period of eight to ten years.
